D.t: Helena Foulkes leads by 10.0 in the forecast and wins 96% of simulations. The cushion is about 42,627 votes; a one point swing is about 2,129 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +3.2 and D +16.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +8.6. Your best recent poll is University of New Hampshire at D +19.2; your worst is Emerson College/WPRI at D +9.7. 5 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Providence, a projected net 27,883 votes; Newport, a projected net 6,547 votes; Bristol, a projected net 5,715 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Kent, R +2.8, 18.0% of the vote; Washington, D +7.1, 15.2% of the vote.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Helena Foulkes runs furthest behind in Newport, Washington. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 80% of voters, 46 to 39, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.98 points; Women, 54% of voters, 55 to 32, where a 5 point gain is worth 2.71 points; Voters without a degree, 53% of voters, 50 to 36, where a 5 point gain is worth 2.63 points.

The forecast's worst groups for Helena Foulkes: Immigration voters 29 to 47, 2024 nonvoters and third party voters 46 to 40, Men 45 to 39. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$215K cash against $264K. Roughly even money; the air war will be decided by outside groups and earned media.
